terms.clause: NYC Admin. Code 23-502(d): public data sets "shall be made available without any registration requirement, license requirement or restrictions on their use".
terms.note: Read on an unofficial mirror of the Administrative Code; the official host (codelibrary.amlegal.com) disallows Anthropic's crawlers in its robots.txt.

document_date_note: The list carries no full date. Its footer reads 'Rev. 12/18' (a month, no day). The PDF's own metadata says created 2018-12-28 and modified 2019-01-03.
extraction_method: pdftotext -layout, page by page; a one-time script read the CODE, DESCRIPTION and PRIORITY columns (row 23's description wraps over two lines and was joined). 97 rows, matching a page-by-page look at the rendered PDF by the same agent. Text kept as printed, including dashes and quotes.
notes: Codes 62 and 63 carry the same description in the source, with priorities A and B; kept as printed. The list does not say what priorities A to D mean. Codes seen in the pulled complaint data but missing from this list (1L, 1X, 2N, 4S, 6S, 6X, 7F, 7G, 7J, 7S on 2026-11-14) decode as not_in_key.
